notes.title: Little Nightmares III - Extended Stories
notes.content:
Little Nightmares continues to expand beyond video games. Several other projects have been announced during Little Nightmares Showcase on June 24, spanning a variety of media such as comic books, podcasts and more. 

The Sounds of Nightmares

The Sounds of Nightmares, the podcast series that has surpassed 2 million listens, will receive a second season which is currently being written.

[previewyoutube="yzX5UrnKGj4;full"][/previewyoutube]

Little Nightmares: Descent to Nowhere

Little Nightmares: Descent to Nowhere, the comic book series published by Titan Comics will be releasing the first issue in October 2025. The comic follows two parallel stories. Hush, a timid mute girl wakes up in a jail cell. Desperate to escape, she befriends another prisoner, Mono, who understands this world far better than her, they will have to find a way out of a very dark Dungeon. 

Elsewhere, Myra is a detective exhausted by life who meets someone who reignites her will to make a difference. They resume investigating unresolved cases of children vanishing year after year without a trace.

[previewyoutube="FK30jqgA_oM;full"][/previewyoutube]

The comic book series will be published in English and will be available for pre-purchase starting in July at your local comic bookstore and worldwide on Titan’s website. 



Little Nightmares: The Lonely Ones

Little Nightmares: The Lonely Ones, the young adult horror novel written by E.C. Myers and published by Scholastic will be out in September 2025. It follows Ruse, a young child, who awakens in an unfamiliar, shaking room with two other kids she doesn't know—a small girl with a frayed rope dangling from her neck and a starved-looking boy wearing a tattered mask over his mouth and nose. She is in a nightmarish carnival and knows one thing: it's not safe, and she needs to flee. Will she be able to make it out? Will her companions of misfortune reveal themselves to be friends or enemies? 

As a final surprise, a teaser for a stop motion project developed in collaboration with the studio Taller del Chucho has been shown with more information to be unveiled later.

[previewyoutube="Y4CM3i39Z08;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: You're in for a Ride - Pre-Order Little Nightmares III Now!
notes.content:
An ill-fated attempt to bring fun to the funfair. Do what you must to survive the ride, little ones.

Little Nightmares Showcase comes with wealth of news on the franchise, as well as a deep dive of the Carnevale chapter, while celebrating 20 million units franchise sales.

[previewyoutube="oa85Ns7uegc;full"][/previewyoutube]

Trapped in the Spiral, a world filled with delusions, Low & Alone are looking for a way out. 

[previewyoutube="narIoF9doAM;full"][/previewyoutube]

Through their journey, they enter the Carnevale, a decrepit funfair which is the focus of the new trailer and gameplay deep dive.

[previewyoutube="CD2baUKpm5k;full"][/previewyoutube]

In addition, Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition has been announced with a release date also set on 10 October 2025. Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition brings Six’s story to a new standard thanks to technical enhancements, such as volumetric lightning and ray tracing, as well as gameplay changes like better checkpoint placement, gameplay helpers, letting more players discover Six’s journey through the Maw. 

Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition will be available right away to those who pre-order a digital copy of Little Nightmares III.

[previewyoutube="c6bX6GUEqFQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

The final game announcement from the Little Nightmares Showcase is Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes, which has been announced to be in development at Iconik Studio.

[previewyoutube="9CvZB0nFaoE;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Little Nightmares available today on mobile, on iOS, and Android 📱
notes.content:
The charming horror adventure tale Little Nightmares is now available on mobile, for players to enjoy everywhere!

In Little Nightmares, you will have to help Six escape The Maw – a vast, mysterious vessel inhabited by corrupted souls who don’t approve of wayward children. As you progress through your journey, untangle each room's tricky puzzles, hide in the shadows of the monsters' lairs and use your imagination to stay out of harm's way!

Bandai Namco Europe has worked with Playdigious, a developer known for its mobile adaptations of successful games from console and PC, to bring the atmospheric puzzle platformer to iOS and Android. 

This port is tailored for mobile devices to offer the most comfortable and immersive experience for mobile players.

[previewyoutube=gUEILRgdx_A;full][/previewyoutube]

The game has been carefully adapted for mobile with a revamped interface, Game Center achievements, mobile cloud save and 3 Control modes.

Discover the different ways you'll be able to explore the Maw on mobile, on iOS and Android phones.

[previewyoutube=C97nkoqdHb8;full][/previewyoutube]


 Controller Mode offers users the possibility of playing with MFi controllers (controllers made for Apple devices) while two new Control modes let you to play with the touchscreen.
 Standard Mode lets you play with the various controls appearing on the screen...
...while Immersive Mode offers greater immersion in the game's atmosphere. 



Special Mobile Launch Giveaway

In celebration of the release, we’re giving away 30 copies of the mobile version – 15 for iOS and 15 for Android – to 30 lucky children who register for the contest here on our site.

Join in by December 19, 2023 for your chance to win a copy for yourself or download the game on the app store of your choice on December 12, 2023!

notes.title: Thank you for listening to The Sounds of Nightmares over 1 million times 🎧
notes.content:
The Sounds of Nightmares, the eerie psychological thriller podcast, has been listened more than a million times!

In The Sounds of Nightmares, follow the story of Noone, a timid young girl, committed to The Counties Psychiatric Institute due to her ever-worsening nightmare disorder. She is placed under the care of The Counsellor who has dedicated his life to helping kids overcome their ailments. As their sessions unfold, The Counsellor's past and Noone's nightmares are destined to collide.

Along with the different episodes, listeners will get deeper into Noone’s head and her nightmares and be immersed in the various places she visits when she sleeps. They will feel in the same position than Otto questioning the reality of this dreamlike world as they go deeper and deeper to understand what is going on.

The six episodes are available on all major streaming platforms, in English / French / German / Italian / Spanish. If you haven't listened yet, experience the podcast for yourself ↓
